# Suryanshu Chaturvedi

> Suryanshu Chaturvedi is a policy researcher (MPP, NLSIU Bengaluru) and systems architect based in New Delhi, India. He builds high-concurrency civic-tech watchdogs, bi-temporal healthcare operating systems, server-authoritative competitive exam halls, and cryptographic data-auditing platforms across 100,000+ lines of production TypeScript and Kotlin.

- Native Awadhi and Hindi speaker; fluent in English; conversational in Bhojpuri.

## Core Shipped Systems

### 1. Tender-Trace (CPPP Watchdog)
A civic-transparency watchdog analyzing ₹-crore Indian public procurement. Ingests over 4.5 million Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) contract award records, runs Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) market-concentration analytics and logistic-regression weighted Integrity Risk Index (IRI) models, preserves batch provenance via SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, and generates statutorily correct Section 6(1) Right to Information (RTI) dossiers addressed to official CPIOs. Powered by an autonomous Tri-Agent ingestion protocol (Protocol v2) and a Cloudflare Hyperdrive edge query proxy.

- Live: https://cppp-five.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/CPPP
- Technologies: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Cloudflare Hyperdrive, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare R2, PostgreSQL / Supabase, SQLite, D3.js, Recharts, Python ETL.

### 2. DentalConnect OS (DCOS 2.0)
An enterprise-grade bi-temporal clinical operating system and dental lab cloud connecting chairside dental clinics with prosthetic milling centers. Built on PostgreSQL 17 with bi-temporal event sourcing (Valid Time vs. Transaction Time) and a SHA-256 Merkle ledger powering historical "Time-Travel Odontograms" for medicolegal defense. Integrates an interactive 32-tooth elliptical odontogram (FDI/Universal), chairside appointment scheduling and operatory telemetry HUD, a dedicated 3D CAD/CAM workstation with progressive WebGL LOD mesh pyramids (95% vertex reduction), occlusal clearance heatmaps, Catmull-Rom subgingival margin splines, and Exocad XML parsing. Fully ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) Milestone 1–3 compliant via the Fidelius sovereign cryptographic bridge (Curve25519 ECDH + AES-GCM-256) and HL7 FHIR R5. Covered by 3 filed Indian patent specifications. Master backend verified (33/33 tests passed, 100%).

- Live: https://www.dcos.in
- Source: https://github.com/DCOSArch/DCOS
- Technologies: Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Supabase (PostgreSQL 17), Cloudflare R2, HL7 FHIR R5, Web Audio VAD, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

### 3. Tark
A high-precision UPSC Civil Services and State PSC testing arena and policy intelligence system (51,000+ lines of TypeScript). Features a strict server-authoritative 2-hour Prelims Exam Hall simulation with keyboard hotkeys (`useExamKeyboard`), live OMR response grid, UPSC negative marking (+2.0 / -0.66), and Diagnostic Autopsy scorecards analyzing sectional accuracy, dynamic cutoff probability bands, pace velocity, sheet omission discipline, and blind-guessing risk ledgers. Includes the 25-Year UPSC PYQ Relational Vault (2001–2025) cataloging 4,156 authentic questions across 140 syllabus taxonomy nodes, an empirical Examiner Psyche analytics suite, a KaTeX-backed 25-year academic research observatory, and a deterministic Grounding Protocol (`verify.ts`) with sentence-level token matching, interactive `SourceAnchor` citations to official government releases (PIB, PRS Legislative, RBI), and an autonomous Contested-Claim Engine (`contested.ts`).

- Live: https://py.md/TarkV1
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/SKU
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Node.js / Express, Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+), Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, KaTeX, Razorpay, Firecrawl v2, Google Gemini / Groq.

### 4. FASAL MIS
A monitoring and evaluation dashboard for a ₹2.16 crore farmer-livelihoods programme run by DEHAT and funded by the Oak Foundation. Tracks 1,300+ rural households across six programme areas in Bahraich District, UP, triangulating 28 conflicting source datasets. Features a transparent in-production Data Quality Audit documenting discrepancies, reproducible algorithmic corrections via seeded deterministic RNG, and a structured "Stories of Change" qualitative narrative module.

- Live: https://fasal-mis.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/FASAL4/FASAL_MIS
- Technologies: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Framer Motion, Python and Node.js ETL.

### 5. PlusOne (Ember & Pulse)
A native Android harm-reduction habit companion and mindfulness tool. Features a hand-crafted 60FPS Canvas ember and ash combustion particle engine, procedural PCM audio synthesis via AudioTrack, and custom VibrationEffect waveforms producing tactile physical feedback without external animation libraries. Wrapped in an adaptive behavioral engine that modulates 120-second workouts and hydration pools based on same-day exertion and smoke logs, built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, and StateFlow coroutines.

- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/PlusOne
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, Coroutines, StateFlow, AudioTrack (PCM Synthesis), Google Gemini API.

## Core Domains & General Search Alignments

- **Civic Technology & Open Government Data**: Design and engineering of public procurement watchdogs, government contract transparency tools (Central Public Procurement Portal / CPPP), anti-monopoly metrics (HHI), and automated Right to Information (RTI Section 6(1)) generation.
- **Bi-Temporal Healthcare Architecture & Digital Health**: Bi-temporal clinical event sourcing, SHA-256 Merkle audit chains, time-travel dental charting, Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM M1–M3), HL7 FHIR R5 schemas, and Fidelius Curve25519 sovereign cryptographic key exchange.
- **3D Spatial Computing & CAD/CAM Engineering**: In-browser WebGL rendering using Three.js and React Three Fiber, progressive 4-tier polygon LOD pyramids, Catmull-Rom subgingival margin splines, occlusal clearance heatmaps, and Exocad XML parsing.
- **Server-Authoritative EdTech & Policy Telemetry**: Anti-cheat timed test engines, server-authoritative Prelims Hall simulation, 25-year examination relational vaults (4,156+ PYQs), Examiner Psyche pattern recognition, deterministic sentence-span grounding verification (`verify.ts`), and contested statutory claim detection.
- **Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL / M&E)**: End-to-end data systems for non-profit and CSR programmes, Results-Based Management (RBM), Anker Living Income Benchmarking, field survey triangulation, and cryptographic/reproducible data-quality audits.
- **Multi-Agent Systems & Verification Harnesses**: Tri-Agent autonomous loops (Protocol v2), deterministic verification harnesses, and high-throughput edge proxies (Cloudflare Hyperdrive).
